goal: Generate a single image suitable for the main visual of a domestic fantasy MMORPG launch, in vertical 3:4 format, with print-quality information layering.

ip.title: The Journey of Qinglu
ip.tagline: One blade opens the mountain, continuing the path of humanity

characters.count: Replace the background with a warm-colored beach at sunset: in the foreground, there are delicate sand patterns and a few small seashells; in the mid-distance, the shallow water's retreating tide line is softly focused, and in the distance, the horizon features an orange-pink gradient sky with a low sun silhouette, with no people or branded items.
items: Main character of young swordsman: high ponytail, dark blue tough outfit, bandaged wrist, long sword with a green edge held horizontally in front, eyes resolute looking towards the rift ahead

A companion of a girl studying both medicine and poison: wearing a moon-white long skirt with a semi-transparent overlay, holding a medicine gourd and several silver needles, standing slightly behind to the side
Guardian spirit beast, Qing Luan chick: half-open wings perched on the protagonist's left shoulder, feathers with emerald luster, a hint of gold in the eyes
characters.composition_relationship: The main character is slightly lower in perspective, centered and slightly forward, with a girl forming a triangle from the upper right rear, and a spirit beast enhancing the dynamic line on the shoulder.

world.scene: Suspended walkways above the cloud mountain range, with a rolling sea of clouds below, and distant peaks revealing a golden semicircle of sunrise, with a large ancient sword scar glowing on the mountain wall.
world.lighting: Cool cyan main light coming from the left, edge warm gold rim light, volumetric fog passing through wooden railing of the walkway

style.art_style: Modern anime semi-realistic + thick painted background + detailed fabric and metal
style.color_palette: Cyan green, Dark Black, Moon White, Warm Gold, accented with a small amount of Vermilion red rope

title_block.position: Centered at the top of the image, leaving a clean cloud band behind the text to avoid overlapping with the character's head.

must_keep: The main character is the absolute visual center, with the highest facial recognizability.
Main light direction unified, volumetric fog and cloud sea perspective consistent
The color palette does not exceed 4 main color blocks
Chinese and English titles should not overlap with the main character's hair bun or sword blade main line
avoid: Crowd image too dense causing faces to be below the recognizable threshold
Excess overly saturated fluorescent color blocks
